i_fs_a_basis: Designer decision 2026-11-15: 6 A full scale, bidirectional. Basis: designer choice. The accuracy requirement (err_limit_pct) is judged at this current.
i_low_a_basis: A, low-current point for the error tables (report only; no limit set at this current).
vbus_mid_v_basis: V, intermediate bus voltage for the power-error table and chart (report choice; the low and high ends come from vbus_lo_v and vbus_hi_v).
vbus_test_v_basis: V, bus voltages for the bus-error table (task spec).
ta_typ_c_basis: degC, typical reference (25 degC) for the typical rows.
t_ref_c_basis: degC, reference temperature for the shunt TCR. The WSK2512 DS states none; 25 degC is an ASSUMPTION.
err_limit_pct_basis: % of reading at i_fs_a: designer requirement 2026-11-15 (+/-1 % of reading, 6 A full scale).
cal_ref_pct_basis: % of reading, one-point calibration reference accuracy (design input, designer 2026-11-15).
cal_ta_c_basis: degC, ASSUMPTION: ambient at the calibration (designer decision 2026-11-15 states 25 degC).
cal_i_a_basis: A, one-point gain calibration at full scale (designer decision 2026-11-15). Set explicitly: it is not tied to i_fs_a. If null or omitted, it defaults to i_fs_a and the report says so.
t_elem_limit_c_basis: degC, ASSUMPTION: shunt element limit, read as the derating curve's zero point (derate_zero). NOT t_oper, which the library records as an AMBIENT rating.
adcrange_basis: INA229 CONFIG ADCRANGE of the instance: 0 = +/-163.84 mV, 1 = +/-40.96 mV. Designer choice with the shunt.
